objective: 3-pair human-information constraint with sequential chain-dependency path construction, trigger transfer, post-trigger tail, and build/fire separation
chainReward: chains <=3 are penalized as destructive early firing. Chains in [5, targetChain) are ramped down toward the static evaluator's own scale (build/fire separation), unless any column height reaches dangerHeight, in which case firing is fully rewarded as an escape valve. targetChain/dangerHeight are tuned empirically (see docs/RESEARCH_NEXT.md, 'PuyoAI12') rather than set from first principles: with only a 3-piece lookahead, suppressing a wide range of chain sizes measurably throws away the lucky windows where a good chain happens to be available without the search being able to see that refusing it will pay off later. A narrow window just above the model's typical ceiling was the only setting that reliably beat the baseline on both average chain and P(>=10) across multiple seeds.
longChainPotential: 0-100 static score combining 2/3-groups, reachable extensions, S-shape construction, human forms, trigger route, queue compatibility, and height pressure. The height/occupied-cell penalty thresholds were shifted up by roughly one row (see docs/RESEARCH_NEXT.md) since a 10+ chain routinely needs the stack to sit taller than the old thresholds tolerated; a larger relaxation and an added packing-efficiency term were both tried and measured to trade away the chain-count tail for more consistent mid-range results, so they were reverted.
notes: AI preserves exact-3 triggers, evaluates latent extension potential, keeps a potential-elite beam subset, and uses only current+2 NEXT pairs. It does not inspect hidden future pieces.
chainDependencyPath: primary latent-chain signal; evaluates the longest sequential hypothetical trigger path and permits repeated colours such as A->B->A->C
branchPolicy: parallel same-wave removals are not rewarded; a small penalty is applied because they consume material without increasing chain count
tuningOverrides: PUYOAI_TARGET_CHAIN / PUYOAI_DANGER_HEIGHT environment variables let tools/chain_benchmark_cli sweep targetChain/dangerHeight without recompiling, for further SPSA-driven or manual tuning
rejectedExperiment_beamDiversity: an earlier revision reserved beamWidth/8 beam slots for the best candidate of each distinct root column not already kept by the score/route/potential/structure passes. Multi-seed benchmarking showed this reliably lowered the achieved chain-count ceiling at small-to-moderate beamWidth (it displaces genuinely strong candidates to make room for weaker, merely-diverse ones), so it was removed rather than shipped. See docs/RESEARCH_NEXT.md, 'PuyoAI12', for the measurements.
